```{python}
#| label: fig-jointplot
#| fig-alt: "Joint plot for Camden Town"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

camden = data[data["LocationID"] == "CamdenTown"]

sspy.jointplot(camden, title="Camden Town", diagonal_lines=True)
plt.show()
```
